contract_accepts_packed_float_input.meaning: the smart contract accepts user-supplied packedFloat input for Float128 calculation

input_passes_sanity_check.meaning: the user-supplied packedFloat is greater than the contract's packedFloat threshold and thus treated as good input
input_passes_sanity_check.checkpoint: before library decode of the submitted packedFloat

input_mantissa_digits.meaning: number of digits of the L_MANTISSA carried by the user-supplied packedFloat with L_MANTISSA_FLAG set
input_mantissa_digits.checkpoint: before library decode of the submitted packedFloat

decoded_mantissa_original.meaning: mantissa returned by decode for the original packedFloat encoding

decoded_mantissa_flipped.meaning: mantissa returned by decode for the packedFloat with L_MANTISSA_FLAG flipped

decoded_exponent_original.meaning: exponent returned by decode for the original packedFloat encoding

decoded_exponent_flipped.meaning: exponent returned by decode for the packedFloat with L_MANTISSA_FLAG flipped

assumptions: The two packedFloat encodings differ only by the L_MANTISSA_FLAG bit, with mantissa and exponent fields otherwise unchanged.
The sanity check is a packedFloat comparison against a threshold; its numeric threshold and direction are not needed for this decode-correspondence claim.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the numeric threshold or comparison direction of the packedFloat sanity check; represented as a grounded Boolean.
Report does not state whether the attacker is permissionless or authorized; the decode-correspondence claim does not depend on caller identity.

limitations: Formalizes only the decode_same_mantissa_exponent impact; other reported impacts are handled in separate passes.
The 72-digit mantissa is encoded as a digit-count equality; the report does not give the concrete mantissa value.
Decoded mantissa/exponent symbols are dimensionless encoded numeric values; no unit conversion is asserted.
